claims.raw: Only the first 4.5 episodes are updated. The rest of them are older, so don’t report any issues to the creator as he’s retired from doing this
This edit only covers The Lost Agent arc. (This is also called the Fullbringer Arc unofficially by fans)

fieldTransformations./recordId: Prefix the exact displayed source identifier with the project namespace; preserve all identifier characters.
fieldTransformations./kind: Classify identifiers containing a decimal point as special; availability remains independent.
fieldTransformations./availability: Apply the approved project-specific release/planning/directive rules without date precedence.
fieldTransformations./generatable: True only when editorial availability is released and runtime state is known; media evidence is still separately required.
fieldTransformations./mangaMapping/tokens: Conservatively tokenize numeric items/ranges while retaining the complete raw mapping.
fieldTransformations./animeMapping/tokens: Conservatively tokenize numeric items/ranges while retaining the complete raw mapping.
fieldTransformations./runtime: Apply the source cell display semantics, then parse mm:ss or h:mm:ss to seconds; do not interpret Hollowed cached serials as elapsed multi-hour runtimes.
fieldTransformations./releaseDate: Parse unambiguous displayed M/D/YY or M/D/YYYY values to ISO while preserving raw and displayed values.
fieldTransformations./lastUpdate: Parse unambiguous displayed M/D/YY or M/D/YYYY values to ISO while preserving raw and displayed values.
fieldTransformations./timeSaved: Parse exact m/s and percent only when the source supplies a matching unstarred value.
